caption: The drawing depicts a metallic, triangular-shaped object with rounded edges and internal webbing, resembling a grate or a structural component. The object has a central circular hole with radial spokes extending outward, creating six segments. Within two of these segments are smaller circular holes aligned with the central axis. The top portion of the drawing provides a flat, plan view where the shape, internal spokes, and holes are clearly visible. Below that, a side profile view shows the object's flat, elevated surface with two small protruding feet for support, accompanied by a linear scale marked in inches for measurement reference. The bottom section of the image features a three-quarter perspective view displaying depth, thickness, and the elevation of the object above the ground. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale tones, showing shading for depth and structure, and the artist's signature, "J. Lipkin," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
